definitions: To distribute the administrative functions or powers of (a central authority) among several local authorities.
To move departments of (a large organization) away from a single central administrative center to other locations.
To transfer control of (a system or organization) from a single central entity to multiple entities or nodes.
examples: The government decentralized power to local councils.
The company decentralized its operations to improve efficiency.
The network was decentralized to enhance security and resilience.
